note: Run by the weekly QA run's acceptance stage as the throwaway account, after the candidate install and the QA key. {bin} is the account's pikkumies. stderr lines are prefixed with the epoch second they arrived (LIVE wrapper) where a case checks that lines arrive while the run works. Patterns are PCRE; a case passes when every expectation holds.

cases.journey: asks over ssh without a terminal with --no-progress --stats and the question on stdin
cases.command:
{bin} --no-progress --stats --prompt-file - <<'Q'
How much disk space is used in my home directory? Answer in one short sentence.
Q

cases.journey: pipes a several-step question and watches the step lines arrive while the agent works
cases.command: LIVE {bin} 'List the three biggest files in my home directory and tell me how much disk space is free.' | cat

cases.journey: pipes the same kind of question with --no-progress
cases.command: {bin} --no-progress 'How much disk space is free? One sentence.' | cat

cases.journey: runs the documented run chat --query-file - call
cases.command:
{bin} run chat --query-file - <<'Q'
What is today's date on this server? One line.
Q

cases.journey: runs run chat with its own --format stream-json and parses the raw stream
cases.command:
{bin} run chat --query-file - --format stream-json <<'Q'
How many files are in my home directory (not recursive)? One line.
Q

cases.journey: types a question with --stats on a real terminal
cases.command: script -qec "timeout 40 {bin} --stats 'say hello in one word'" /dev/null

expect.stdout_re: --no-progress and --stats are for a one-shot question

cases.journey: asks the agent to write a config file with a token in it and run a command with a password argument
cases.command: {bin} 'Create the file ~/accept-uc07.conf containing the line api_token=uc07SECRETvalue12345 and then run: mysql --version --password=uc07PASSWORDvalue || true' | cat; rm -f ~/accept-uc07.conf

cases.journey: asks the agent to read a file that does not exist
cases.command: {bin} 'Read the file ~/this-file-does-not-exist-uc08.txt with your file reading tool and tell me what it says.' | cat

cases.journey: runs a question with the halt guard on and sees any continue said on stderr, never mixed into stdout
cases.command: {bin} 'Make a directory ~/accept-uc09, put three small text files in it, then list them.' | cat; rm -rf ~/accept-uc09

cases.journey: resumes the session from the session_id line with a follow-up question
cases.command: id=$({bin} --no-progress 'Remember the word kantele. Reply OK.' 2>&1 >/dev/null | sed -n 's/^session_id: //p' | tail -1); test -n "$id" && {bin} --no-progress --resume "$id" 'Which word did I ask you to remember? One word.' | cat

cases.journey: runs a piped question under LANG=C with stderr to a file
cases.command: LANG=C LC_ALL=C {bin} 'How much disk space is free? One sentence.' 2>~/accept-uc11.err | cat; cat ~/accept-uc11.err >&2; rm -f ~/accept-uc11.err

cases.journey: types --stats with no question
cases.command: {bin} --stats </dev/null | cat; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cases.journey: the candidate installed over the latest release shows a clean doctor and the switches work
cases.command: {bin} doctor >/dev/null && {bin} --stats 'Reply with the single word ready.' | cat

cases.journey: asks a question that makes the agent start a helper agent
cases.command: {bin} --stats 'Use your delegate_task tool to start one helper agent that reports the free disk space, then tell me what it found.' | cat

cases.journey: runs a piped question with PIKKUMIES_DEPTH=1 set as an agent would
cases.command: PIKKUMIES_DEPTH=1 {bin} 'How much disk space is free? One sentence.' | cat

cases.journey: asks with an unreachable model endpoint for this run
cases.command: {bin} -m no-such-model-uc16 'hello' | cat; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cases.journey: the run is killed while it works
cases.command: timeout -s KILL 25 {bin} 'Count slowly from 1 to 50 using the terminal tool, one sleep 1 per number.' | cat; true

cases.journey: with the halt guard turned off a piped question still shows its steps
cases.command: cp ~/pikkumies/local/config.php ~/accept-uc18.bak; php -r '$f=getenv("HOME")."/pikkumies/local/config.php";$c=is_file($f)?include $f:[];$c["halt"]["disabled"]=true;file_put_contents($f,"<?php return ".var_export($c,true).";\n");'; {bin} 'How much disk space is free? One sentence.' | cat; mv ~/accept-uc18.bak ~/pikkumies/local/config.php

cases.journey: sees narration lines under the steps, and none once the day's narration calls are used up
cases.command: {bin} 'List the files in my home directory and say how many there are.' | cat; cp ~/pikkumies/local/config.php ~/accept-uc19.bak; php -r '$f=getenv("HOME")."/pikkumies/local/config.php";$c=is_file($f)?include $f:[];$c["hooks"]["dailyCalls"]["narrate"]=0;file_put_contents($f,"<?php return ".var_export($c,true).";\n");'; {bin} 'How many files are in my home directory? One line.' 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -c 'no more narration today' >&2; mv ~/accept-uc19.bak ~/pikkumies/local/config.php

cases.journey: puts --no-progress alone in an alias and starts an interactive session on a terminal
cases.command: script -qec "timeout 20 {bin} --no-progress" /dev/null; true
